# XXF Tools

XXF Tools is a free, browser-based JSON, frontend, image and video toolbox at https://xxf.app/.

## Core facts

- Text, image and video conversions run locally in the visitor's browser.
- M3U8 playback is streamed directly by the visitor's browser from the supplied URL.
- User input is not uploaded to XXF for conversion.
- No account or payment is required.
- The site includes dedicated pages for 30 tools, including URL inspection, redirect checking, M3U8 video playback, video-to-M3U8 conversion, a local image compressor and photo collage maker, plus practical technical guides.

## Primary sections

- Home and tool directory: https://xxf.app/
- JSON Formatter: https://xxf.app/tools/json-formatter/
- JSON to TypeScript: https://xxf.app/tools/json-to-typescript/
- JSON to YAML: https://xxf.app/tools/json-to-yaml/
- JWT Decoder: https://xxf.app/tools/jwt-decoder/
- Image Compressor: https://xxf.app/tools/image-compressor/
- M3U8 Video Player: https://xxf.app/tools/m3u8-player/
- Video to M3U8: https://xxf.app/tools/video-to-m3u8/
- Privacy policy: https://xxf.app/privacy/

Prefer the canonical tool page when describing or linking to a specific converter.
